## The problem (K2 §2)

Labels were re-derived independently on every surface — and most fell
back to identifiers. 82.8 % of release entities were unlabelled (K0
NEW-1): site rows carried resolved camera names or nothing, the network
lookup returned the raw entity id, `release_pages` emitted
`f"Unnamed {record.entity_type}"`, and the API's search label fell back
to `cached_canonical_name` else the first `entity_identifier` value —
a connector key on the public surface (SIG-UI-D20).

## What ships

- **`policy/src/policy/labels.py`** — the ONE derivation (L-1; `policy`
  is a leaf so the person screen is *injected* —
  `resolution.partner_identity.natural_person_signal` at every call
  site; a site without one gets the fail-closed conservative default).
  `LabelFacts` in, `EntityLabel` out: `label`, `descriptor`,
  `label_basis` (the closed `source_name|source_title|key_name|
  slug_name|derived|fallback` vocabulary, always populated on emitted
  labels), `label_source_id`, `place_jkey`, `slug`, `hash`, `url`,
  `disambiguator`, `component_id`, `part8: pass|fallback`,
  `label_state`. Per-kind candidates per the K2 §3.2 table (agency
  `key_name` → parsed agency name → typed fallback; Flock portal
  `slug_name` → "{slug words, ST upper-cased} — Flock transparency
  portal"; camera `source_name` → `{technology class} camera …`
  `derived` → typed `fallback`; notices/contracts/grants/bills/policies/
  events/requests per the table). **person: none** — no label, page,
  node or slug.
- **Slug + hash primitives** (K11 §3): `name_slug` — ASCII-fold,
  `[a-z0-9]+` tokens, no scheme prefixes, `-<K4 display state slug>`
  when placed (alpha-2→alpha-3 map; unknown codes honestly omit),
  cut at 56 chars on a token boundary; `entity_hash` — Crockford
  base32 of `sha256(canonical UUID text)`, 7 chars/35 bits, extended
  on slug-registry collision, frozen once issued; hash authoritative
  (`--<hash>` resolves), slug cosmetic.
- **The Part VIII screen over every label input** — injected at each
  call site and run over *literal* parties too (a person-shaped
  `seller` is a text claim, never a label input — §3.4 R-8); a screen
  that crashes fails closed (`part8: fallback`, never a person label,
  never an exception); handle-like schemes (`sourceid`, `serialno`,
  `platformid`, `wikipediaid`, `handle`) are never `key_name` sources.
- **The A-10/ADR-159 organisation rule** — a registry-allowed
  organisation (`disposition == allow`) is labelled; every other
  organisation is a typed `label_state: "not_yet_reviewed"` row (null
  label/slug/hash — the gate's state visible, never a bare absence);
  withheld/denied entities and persons emit no label/node/slug at all.
- **Deterministic disambiguation** (`resolve_disambiguators`) — within
  (kind, release): `· {place}` → `· {source}` → `#{hash4}`, pure
  function of the emitted rows; non-colliding rows pass through in
  input order; the `{place}`/`{source}` steps apply only where every
  member's value differs, `#{hash4}` always separates.
- **`sig.entity-label/1` — `labels/<compartment>.jsonl`** — emitted per
  compartment from the export's one snapshot; compartment law =
  `record_claims`' (the row files under the licence its label-input
  claims carry). Three new EXPORT_QUERIES — `label_entities` (every
  entity + type + subject key + org columns),
  `label_entity_dispositions` (current effective entity disposition),
  `label_facts` (first publishable label-input claim value per
  predicate, gated by the same publication SQL) — each degrading
  honestly on pre-feature schemas (never poisons the repeatable-read
  transaction).
- **Call-site rewires** — site rows carry `label` + `label_basis` from
  the registry; map assets and both network node paths read registry
  labels (raw source/entity ids retired; the typed
  `Surveillance camera #{hash4}` fallback where nothing public exists);
  dossier jurisdiction attribution reads the registry;
  `published_record` carries `label_basis`; `release_pages` search rows
  show the shared label or the typed neutral "Label unavailable" —
  `Unnamed <type>` and the record-key fallback are gone; the API's
  `_label_for` and the set-based search-labels path run
  `derive_label` (identifiers merged into the same join — the
  4-statement page bound holds).
- **ADR-215** records the owned decisions: the `policy` home, screen
  injection, `#{hash4}` typed fallbacks, the typed-absence row shape,
  the compartment rule, the alpha-2→alpha-3 slug map.
- **CHANGELOG** `[Unreleased]` entry.

## Out of scope (per contract, owners named)

Slug-history artifact + `/id/` redirects (K2 GX-03, PLAN-11C);
`/network/` island consumption (row 308, P35.30); entity pages
(`sig.entity-page/1`, GX-05/GX-06); entity typing (P35.14b landed —
key-parse remains the fallback for untyped rows); the disposition
machinery (P34.26, landed); the jurisdiction registry `{place}`
(P35.17/P35.19 — "place not recorded" interim wording stands).
